name: TOI-7137

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-7394 B and TOI-7137 in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 1602132340256374528 and 1602132344550079232), 741 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 1.8e-5: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to TOI-7394 B, 741 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 161687209 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

mass.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 161687209 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 161687209 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: TOI-7137 is a star of 4,220 K, bound to TOI-7394 B 741 AU away.
text.introduction: TOI-7137 shares its motion through space with TOI-7394 B, 741 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: TOI-7137's orbit around TOI-7394 B is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
